name: aem-cli trigger queries
description: Should trigger when installing, running, configuring or troubleshooting the AEM CLI (aem up / aem content / aem import), including local preview and DA content sync; near misses are block coding, content format, import, testing and DA API work that only mention the dev server in passing.

queries.query: npm install -g @adobe/aem-cli fails with EEXIST: file already exists /opt/homebrew/bin/hlx. How do I get the new CLI installed?
I just cloned our EDS site repo. Get the local dev server running so I can see the homepage on my machine.
aem up keeps failing with 'unable to get local issuer certificate' on my work laptop. We're behind Zscaler. Fix it.
I need a local-only test page with the new carousel block so I can see it through the dev server before anything is authored. Set that up.
Pull down the /products folder from our da.live site, I want to bulk-edit the pages locally and then send them back up.
Our SSO callback only accepts https. Make the local EDS dev server run on https://localhost:8443 and keep that setting for everyone on the team.
I have two git worktrees of the site open and want both dev servers running at the same time without one killing the other. How?
localhost:3000 shows 404 for /about but the page is live on our .aem.live site. What's wrong with my local setup?
I ran aem content push and it said 3 files pushed, but https://main--site--org.aem.page/products/new still shows the old page. Why?
Start the importer UI locally so I can run our import.js against a few URLs.
aem content clone says 'Unknown argument: content'. I installed the CLI a year ago. What do I do?
Point my local dev server at our stage site instead of main so I can test against stage content.
I want to look at how our da.live pages under /blog render with my local block changes before I push any code. Get that content onto my machine and show it through the local server.
Write the decorate function and CSS for a new stats block: each row has a number and a label, show them as a responsive grid.
What HTML does da.live expect for a cards block with an image and a caption in each card? I'm generating the page source from a script.
Import https://www.example-bakery.com/about into our EDS project as a page, keeping the hero and the team grid.
Add unit tests for the tabs block's keyboard navigation using the test setup the project already has.
Our CI job needs to call the DA admin API to list pages. How do we get an IMS token for a service account?
Review the open PR that adds a quote block. Check it against EDS conventions and leave comments only.
Design the authoring table for a pricing block: plans, prices, feature lists and a highlighted plan. Authors use Word.
Our homepage LCP is 4s on mobile. The hero image is in the first section. Find out why and fix it in the code.
